title: Fail malformed Ollama verification responses without recovery loops
description: Independent ARA-053 review reproduced HTTP-200 model_info=null raising AttributeError in verification. The actor logged the error, while expired-lease recovery could repeat verification indefinitely and fence local inference. Validate malformed inventory/metadata/probe shapes at the runtime boundary and persist a safe terminal failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given malformed runtime inventory or model metadata, when inspected or verified, then a structured safe protocol error is returned rather than an unhandled shape exception.
Given a verification-only job and a permanent malformed response, when the worker executes, then failure is persisted without a pull or indefinite recovery loop.
Given valid runtime responses, when verification executes, then the existing streaming, structured-output and thinking probes retain their behavior.
test_cases: Malformed tags, capabilities, model_info/context lengths, probe messages and streaming events.
Real isolated PostgreSQL job failure/recovery and no-pull assertions.
Existing local runtime and full backend regressions.
verification: Observed RED: 41 failed, 7 passed; corrected boundary GREEN: 48 passed, including 10 isolated PostgreSQL automatic-job outcomes. Safe permanent MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR records one failure attempt, clears the lease, preserves weights, and prevents recovery/reconciliation/pull loops. Final backend suite passed 365 tests in 44.08 seconds with Ruff clean. Focused cross-review independently passed 38 unit and 10 SQL cases. Retained real 7B passed the updated boundary with six controls, streaming and structured output, hosted key empty; all 12 browser scenarios passed. Cancellation and valid/unusable response semantics remain covered; no generic database exception catch.
